title: Arlington, VA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Arlington, VA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Arlington is a city in VA with a population of 240,000. Urban county across the Potomac from DC with the Pentagon and a vibrant Rosslyn-Ballston corridor. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
